theme: New York to Florida, a travel day winding down.
greeting: Neurology at HSS this afternoon, then wheels-up from LaGuardia to Florida this evening. You land in St. Pete tonight, and the Kenwood place is yours through Labor Day week.

needsAttention.title: Book the final Dubrovnik night
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 room in Cavtat, near DBV airport, is still open (p1, due yesterday). You disembark the charter by 8 AM Saturday and fly out 7:30 AM Sunday, so book close to the airport.

recipe.title: Olive oil-poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Late summer's glut of zucchini and tomatoes asks for nothing more than good olive oil.

acts.line: A quiet start with nothing on the calendar before midday.
Neurology with Dr. Manning at HSS, arriving by 1:45.
DL 2433 out of LaGuardia at 6:30, into Florida by 9:50.
